title: North Link Building
subtitle: #04-xx — Ramp-Up Factory with Mezzanine
description:
4th-storey ramp-up B1 factory unit with mezzanine at North Link Building, Admiralty. Total strata area of approximately 5,199 sqft (483 sqm) comprising 1st floor 274 sqm, 2nd floor 60 sqm, and void area 149 sqm.

Leasehold 60 years from 09 October 1999 — approximately 33 years remaining.
